nodes.name: Hydrothermal synthesis of NiMoO4
nodes.procedure: nickel nitrate hexahydrate (0.8 mmol), ammonium molybdate (0.2 mmol), and nickel foam (1.5 cm × 1.5 cm) were dissolved in 50 ml of deionized water. After vigorous ultrasound for 1 h, the homogeneous suspension with nickel foam was evaporated in an oven at 160 °C for 6 h.

nodes.name: Electrochemical synthesis of e·NiMoO4
nodes.procedure: Electrochemical synthesis of NiMoO4 with an epitaxial catalytic layer (e·NiMoO4) was achieved using a standard three-electrode system on a CHI 760E electrochemistry workstation in a mixed solution of nickel chloride (0.04 M), KOH (1.0 M), and sodium citrate (0.06 M). The NiMoO4 precursor served as the working electrode, a Ag/AgCl electrode as the reference electrode, and platinum as the counter electrode. For the electrochemical synthesis of large-scale electrodes, a DC power supply equipped with a peristaltic pump-driven circulation system was employed under ambient temperature and pressure. The current was maintained at 200 mA/cm2. The resulting samples were cleaned and dried in a vacuum oven overnight at 80 °C.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM and HRTEM imaging revealed a rough surface on e·NiMoO4 with nanodendrites < 10 nm showing (100) lattice fringes of Ni(OH)2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The dynamically constructed layer also has densely packed nanodendrites smaller than 10 nm in size ... lattice fringes corresponding to the (100) facet of nickel hydroxide (Supplementary Fig. 4e–f).

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS shows Mo 3d shifting to lower binding energies and the emergence of low valence Ni peaks, indicating surface reconstruction.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Following the formation of e·NiMoO4 , Mo 3 d shifts to lower binding energies with the emergence of low valence Ni peak in Ni 2p spectrum ...

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando Ni K-edge XANES shows that under bias, the Ni oxidation state in e·NiMoO4 oscillates in a small range, whereas NiMoO4 shows a significant decrease in oxidation state.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Ni K-edge XANES spectra indicate a lower oxidation state of Ni in e·NiMoO4 compared to NiMoO4 ... in the e·NiMoO4 system, the oxidation state of Ni oscillates within a small range during bias application.

nodes.characterization_summary: STEM and aberration-corrected HAADF-STEM imaging illustrated the epitaxial core-shell relationship between the NiMoO4 core and Ni(OH)2 shell.
nodes.evidence_snippet: STEM mapping at various magnifications, including aberration-corrected imaging, clearly illustrates the epitaxial relationship between the NiMoO4 core and the Ni(OH)2 shell (Supplementary Fig. 5b, c).
